task.title: Workbench: close two removal edge cases left from the project-removal review
task.description:
Found during review of PR #202 (remove a project from Workbench). Both are in code that change did not touch, so they were left out of it.

1. Warm-view path in layInBoard (desktop/src/main/main.js, after loadURL for an already-warm board view): it does not check whether the project was removed while the page loaded. A removal landing there leaves activeProjectId pointing at the removed project and calls focus() on webContents that have already been closed. The cold path has this check; the warm path should get the same one, with a test in the style of board-park.test.js.

2. registry.remove drops the project from memory before awaiting the save. A board start that crosses its still-listed check during the save treats the project as removed and stops or aborts its board. If the save then fails, the rollback brings the project back with no server running. Either hold the in-memory removal until the save succeeds, or restart the board on rollback.

Also noted, not known to be reachable: two overlapping supervisor.start calls for the same project can both spawn if they interleave while the binary is being located (pre-existing; both start paths await a presence check first, and the binary location is cached after the first call).
